points.text: Actor Stacy Keach, known for playing Mike Hammer and for his role in Fat City, has died at 85.
Workers across Spain began the country’s first general strike in 14 years, disrupting transport, industry and some schools and universities ahead of a November 29 election.
A vehicle struck people near a food stand by the North Hollywood Metro station, killing three and critically injuring several others.
The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 11,000 cases, according to government data.
An 11-month-old boy reported missing in South Carolina was found alive in a buried dog crate and taken to hospital; his father was arrested, according to reports.
